label: Same actual necessary root with immateriality, intellect and will
term: same necessary root with structural immateriality, intellect and will
definition: There exists one bearer n that is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w and exists at every world accessible from w. Its represented esseOf and essenceOf values agree in the supplied profile. It is noncomposite, and anything simply prior to it is identical to it. It is free of matter-form composition and is a component of no bearer. It satisfies both the supplied HasIntellect and HasWill predicates. All conjuncts apply to that same n.
note: Proof provenance: RootIntellectWill.necessaryRootIntellectWill composes the eleven-input nonlimitation proof with the structural tail. It retains excluded middle and adds the composition-kinds, component-exclusion, immaterial-to-intellect and intellect-to-will premises. That is one fifteen-input producer of this existential. The producer and its attempts track the open q14/q19 interpretation and applicability obligations.
